Carrying Apple devices out and about often means lugging around a whole bunch of charging cables and plug adapters. The RORRY Flow power bank integrates everything you need into a single compact charger, solving all your hassles in one go. It features built-in foldable prongs, an integrated USB-C cable, and a magnetic charger designed specifically for the Apple Watch. This accessory is definitely a must-have for my travels—whether you need a quick top-up on the go or an overnight charge, it handles everything with ease.

MagSafe Monday column: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers breaks down the latest developments in the MagSafe and wireless charging industry, helping you get the most out of your Apple device's wireless charging capabilities.

Designed specifically for travel

The back of the RORRY Flow power bank features built-in foldable prongs, allowing you to plug it directly into a hotel or vacation rental wall outlet to charge the power bank—no need to carry a separate plug. It also comes with a built-in USB-C cable (I absolutely love this design!), meaning even if you want to charge an iPhone, iPad, Kindle, Switch, or other device, you don't need to bring an extra cable.

Although I usually focus on iPhone MagSafe features, this power bank has a built-in 5W magnetic charging module designed for the Apple Watch. When your Apple Watch is running low on battery, just place it on top and you can easily top it up—super convenient. It holds the watch securely in place, so you can charge it even without the original charger.

This power bank has a capacity of 10,000mAh, enough to provide all-day power for your iPhone and Apple Watch during travel. For me, the most useful feature is its 40W USB-C output; even if your MacBook Air has shut down due to a dead battery, it can help you get an emergency boost.

RORRY Flow power bank summary

If you want to lighten your load when traveling with Apple devices, the RORRY Flow power bank is a great choice. It combines a wall plug charger, Apple Watch charging cable, and USB-C cable into one, with a simple design that's easy to slip into a backpack or pocket.

You can purchase the RORRY Flow portable charger directly from RORRY or Amazon.
